name: Coconut-heart salad
summary: Vietnam Tourism calls củ hủ dừa a light salad of coconut heart, with the coconut rice and the coconut-braised shrimp. The provincial tourism portal, 4 June 2021, names gỏi củ hủ dừa tôm thịt: coconut heart, tiger prawn, pork belly, laksa leaf, roasted peanut, fried shallot, and carrot, in a lime-and-sugar dressing. The heart is the youngest shoot, white and mildly sweet, and a tree is cut to take it. A price is check on arrival.
origin: The grove lunch on Vietnam Tourism, and guest tables on the provincial tourism portal.
culture: The 4 June 2021 article says this salad and rice steamed in a coconut were named among 100 Vietnamese dishes for 2011–2016 by Vietkings. That is the portal’s account. The article says the salad is a guest dish, including weddings, death anniversaries, and full-month feasts. It also says some palms are grown for the heart, so the cut is not only a felled crop tree.
texture: The portal says the prawn is crisp and the pork belly is rich, against the white heart. Soak the cut heart in cold water with a little lime juice so it stays white.
taste: The portal calls the heart mildly sweet and cool, and the finished salad sour-sweet, rich, and easy. Vietnam Tourism calls it a light salad and does not print a dressing.
howToEat: Vietnam Tourism: eat the light salad at the grove lunch with the coconut rice and the coconut-braised shrimp.

The 4 June 2021 method: cut the heart into short strips, boil the prawns and the pork belly, slice the pork and the carrot, and toss with laksa leaf in a lime-and-sugar dressing. Finish with roasted peanut and fried shallot. The article says garlic-chili fish sauce and a shrimp cracker on the side. That cracker is not bánh phồng Sơn Đốc.
A stall price was not printed. The price is check on arrival.
where: Tourism stops and guest tables. Vietnam Tourism puts the salad on the grove lunch. The portal does not name a street.
seoTitle: Coconut-heart salad in Ben Tre — two accounts
seoDescription: Vietnam Tourism calls củ hủ dừa a light salad. The provincial portal prints a prawn-and-pork gỏi with a lime dressing. A price is check on arrival.
